excel_steps.Message Content (English): You’ve chosen Family Schemes. I’ll ask a few short questions about your household so I can show schemes that may be relevant.
excel_steps.Notes: Flow 2: Family Scheme Discovery. Same hybrid style as Journey 1 — conversational collection, deterministic matching.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which state does your family currently live in?
excel_steps.Notes: State selection. BOT is intended for citizens of India.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): How many people live in your household, including you?
How many children under 18 are in the household?
How many household members are aged 60 or above?
Does anyone in the household have a disability?
excel_steps.Option Label: Yes | No | Prefer not to say

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Is anyone in the household pregnant or breastfeeding?
excel_steps.Option Label: Yes | No | Prefer not to say
excel_steps.Notes: Used to surface maternal / ICDS / PMMVY-type schemes.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): What is the primary occupation of the household?
excel_steps.Option Label: Farmer | Labourer | Salaried | Self-employed | Unemployed | Other
excel_steps.Notes: Family occupation taxonomy is shorter than Journey 1 (no Student / Homemaker / Retired).

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which range best describes your total monthly household income?
What best describes your family's housing?
excel_steps.Option Label: Own - Pucca | Own - Kutcha | Rented | Homeless / No permanent housing | Other
excel_steps.Notes: Kutcha / rented / homeless boost housing scheme matches.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): What type of ration card does the household have?
excel_steps.Option Label: Antyodaya (AAY) | BPL | APL | Other | None | Not sure
excel_steps.Notes: AAY / BPL used for food security and poverty-targeted schemes.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Does the household have health insurance?
excel_steps.Notes: Insurance = No surfaces health insurance schemes (Ayushman / PM-JAY / Arogya).

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Which social category would you like to select?
Here’s what I have so far. Please check your household details before I look for matching schemes.
excel_steps.Notes: Deterministic confirmation gate — same as Journey 1.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Based on the information you shared, here are the schemes that may be relevant to your family. Choose one to learn more.
excel_steps.Notes: Family-aware eligibility scoring. Final eligibility depends on official verification.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Here are the key details for this scheme. What would you like to do next?
excel_steps.Notes: Go Back returns to the matched-scheme list without re-collecting the profile.

excel_steps.Message Content (English): Would you like to go back to the main menu or end this chat?
excel_steps.Notes: Shared end menu / feedback / referral gates with Journey 1. Ratings 1–2 end; 3–5 offer referral.
